description: Plugin names and namespaces (DESIGNS No. 13). A name's namespace is the text before its first dot, or the bare name. Reserved namespaces belong to the built-in plugin `harnessweaver`. Cases check `owner_of` (which plugin owns a name), `qualify` (a plugin's bare names get its namespace), `owns` (whether a plugin may contribute a name), `allowed` (plugins.allow; null allows everything, the built-in plugin is always allowed) and `namespace` (valid plugin namespaces).
